summary: Busy shop-strip kerb with apartments 7 m away and signed day parking.
reasons: Apartment block 7 m from the kerb

best_section.where: West end of the south kerb by the small park, beside the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Central Park Residences apartments sit about 7 m from the kerb; cafes and shops face the street opposite at 13 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane where other cars park, so a van fits; no lay-by.
drivers.traffic: Town-centre street near a junction with constant foot and car traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but the signs are daytime turnover (2P, 3P, passenger loading zone).

flags: Dwelling about 7 m from the best section
Daytime time limits signed on this kerb
Noise from shops and the junction
sun_shade: Open sky; apartment block shades the kerb from the south, park open to the west.
